title: Side Bets — sector ETF universe for the Bower composite sector indexes
purpose: Every US sector ETF considered for each GICS sector, the funds included in each Bower composite, and the reason for every exclusion. The collector (scripts/side-bets-collect.cjs) reads `included` from this file; editing it changes the composites.
inclusionRule: Dedicated to one GICS sector of US equities, tracking a passive index (no active, leveraged, inverse, options-income, factor/smart-beta or thematic funds).
Same sector definition: the index must classify by GICS. Funds on other sector definitions (FTSE Russell / ICB-style, REIT-only) are listed as exclusions with evidence, not blended.
Market-cap weighted (capped or uncapped). Equal-weight sector funds are a different construction and are excluded.
From a major provider with a full lineup across the 11 GICS sectors, so every composite is built from the same providers. Partial lineups are listed as watch items.
Has a free, no-key daily price source with at least a year of history (Cboe's public delayed-quote daily closes).
returnBasis: Price return for every fund: Cboe's daily closes are split-adjusted but not dividend-adjusted. No free source of total-return or distribution history was used, so no fund is on a total-return basis.

used.name: Cboe delayed quotes — daily closes
used.note: All 56 candidate tickers checked (SPDR, Vanguard, iShares, Fidelity, Invesco, SCHH): each has daily history through 2026-11-09.

notUsed.name: Stooq daily CSV
notUsed.reason: Returns an HTML JavaScript proof-of-work bot check instead of CSV ('This site requires JavaScript to verify your browser'). Not bypassed. Same result as in phase 1.
